title: effect_settings_adjust body has zero exec-level coverage — deleting the apply/persist wiring passes CI (the r5 pause-wiring trap, adjust twin)
evidence: app/main.odin effect_settings_adjust body: `app.a11y.palette = rnd.Palette_Mode(cycle_palette(...)); rnd.palette_apply_mode(&app.palette_base, &app.palette, app.a11y.palette)` ... `app.view.ui_scale = scale_of(app.a11y.scale_step)` ... `settings_save(app.a11y)`. grep 'effect_settings_adjust|SETTINGS_ROW_PALETTE|SETTINGS_ROW_SCALE' app/*_test.odin → no matches. harness/parity.odin:1274: `if runs[i].panel_adjusts < 1 { ... "the row activation must reach the adjust effect" }` — parity replaces the hook with parity_settings_adjust_hook (a counter), never the app effect.
detail: Pure helpers (cycle_scale/cycle_palette/adjust_step) and hook-firing are pinned, but no test drives effect_settings_adjust itself. Deleting palette_apply_mode/view.ui_scale/settings_save there — or swapping rows — passes all tests, exactly like the r5 pause blocker.
recommended_fix: Add an exec-level test (the settings_chip_click_pauses_end_to_end pattern): construct App, call effect_settings_adjust per row with delta 0/±1, assert view.ui_scale/palette/motion change and settings_save_at writes (path-injected).

title: Settings_Navigate row-wrap boundaries (Up from row 0, Down from row 3) untested
evidence: app/input/exec.odin: `if inp.panel_open { n := i32(rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT); r := inp.panel_row + v.delta; if r < 0 { r += n }; if r >= n { r -= n }; inp.panel_row = r }`. Parity scenario input_parity_settings_panel only drives one Dpad_Down/Down (0→1); grep 'panel_row' app/*_test.odin → no matches.
detail: The wrap branches (row 0 Up→3, row 3 Down→0) are new state transitions with no test; a broken wrap regresses pad/keyboard navigation CI-silent. P2 gap.
recommended_fix: Add a unit/parity leg: open panel, send Up from row 0 (expect row 3) and Down from row 3 (expect row 0).
